title: mikania fulva
intro: Mikania fulva, commonly known as Wild Scutellaria or Yellow Mikania, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, digestive issues, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Mikania fulva are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antiseptic, antitumor, and anti-inflammatory activities. The plant's bioactive compounds have also demonstrated potential in modulating the immune system, providing protection against oxidative stress, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity against various pathogens.
